question.en: What is the special importance of a telescope in space?
question.zh: 太空中的望远镜有什么特别重要的意义？

sentences.en: What is the special importance of a telescope in space?
sentences.zh: 太空中的望远镜有什么特别重要的意义？

sentences.en: The Hubble telescope was launched into
space by NASA on April 20, 1990 at a cost of over a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 由美国国家航空航天局于1990年4月20日送入太空，耗资十多亿美元。

chunks.x: at a cost of over a billion dollars

sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble.
sentences.zh: 从一开始哈勃望远镜就有麻烦。

sentences.en: The pictures it sent us were very disappointing because its main mirror was faulty!
sentences.zh: 它发回的照片非常令人失望，因为它的主镜有毛病！

chunks.x: because its main mirror was faulty

sentences.en: NASA is now going to put the telescope right,
sentences.zh: 航空航天局现在准备把望远镜修好，

sentences.en: so it will soon be sending up four astronauts to repair it.
sentences.zh: 因此不久将把四名宇航员送上太空去修理它。

chunks.x: so will soon be sending up astronauts

sentences.en: The shuttle Endeavour will be taking the astronauts to the Hubble.
sentences.zh: “奋进”号航天飞机将把宇航员送到哈勃望远镜那里。

sentences.en: A robot-arm from the Endeavour will grab the telescope and hold it while the astronauts make the necessary repairs.
sentences.zh: “奋进”号上的机械臂将抓住望远镜并把它固定住，宇航员进行必要的修理。

sentences.en: Of course, the Hubble is above the earth's atmosphere,
sentences.zh: 当然，哈勃望远镜位于地球大气层之上，

sentences.en: so it will soon be sending us the clearest pictures of the stars and distant galaxies that we have ever seen.
sentences.zh: 因此它不久将给我们发回前所未见的、最清晰的恒星和遥远星系的照片。

chunks.x: so will soon be sending pictures
of the stars and distant galaxies that we have ever seen

sentences.en: The Hubble will tell us a great deal about the age and size of the universe.
sentences.zh: 哈勃望远镜将告诉我们许多关于宇宙年龄和大小的情况。

chunks.x: about the age and size of the universe

sentences.en: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands and thousands of wonderful pictures.
sentences.zh: 等你读到这篇文章时，哈勃望远镜这只“鹰眼”将已经给我们送回成千上万张美妙的照片。

chunks.x: By the time you read this
